{{Top|leg}}
A '''hydroprocessor''' was a type of machine used in a kitchen that made a whirring sound when used. The [[Brakiss's mother|mother]] of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Brakiss]] kept a hydroprocesser on the kitchen counter in her home on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Msst]].<ref name="The New Rebellion">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref> In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the women turned on the hydroprocesser during a conversation with the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who had ventured to Msst in search of information regarding her son's activities.<ref name="The New Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
The hydroprocesser was created by [[Kristine Kathryn Rusch]] and appeared in the [[1996]] [[Bantam Spectra]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel ''[[The New Rebellion]]''.<ref name="The New Rebellion" />
